cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tied our letters in bundles like yours. Take half to sort before the removal van comes; we both filled this box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tied mine so they wouldn't fall out. I haven't chosen what to keep.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, ready for the van. Sit with me and we'll choose together; I can't decide what ten years means on my own.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose a day we'll open it together. You can carry the box without having to carry all the deciding.
